description: Source code for passphrase management, including functions for setting, changing, and retrieving user passphrases, with file handling and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program; parses command-line arguments and initiates passphrase setting process.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Handles the process of setting a passphrase for a user, including verification and updating the password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes the password in the specified password file, creating backups as needed.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Creates a new password entry with cryptographic hashing based on user credentials.

methods.name: t_pwcopy
methods.description: Copies password entries from one file to another, optionally replacing an entry.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password entry from the input stream.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to the output stream.
